name: setup-manaflow-ai-codex-threads
description: A customize section that lists your agent chats the way a desktop coding agent app's activity view does: Priority first (chats that need input), then Today and Yesterday headings, Mark all as read (the chat's own read mark) and Clear read chats, and an Archive view with search and Unarchive. Settings turn on cmux's own priority bell and Settled folding to match. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
